hints.title: 1D Interval Overlap Projections
hints.text: Two rectangles overlap if and only if their horizontal and vertical interval projections both strictly overlap.

hints.title: Strict Interval Intersection
hints.text: Two 1D intervals [a1, a2] and [b1, b2] overlap with positive length if min(a2, b2) > max(a1, b1).

hints.title: Area Positivity Condition
hints.text: Check min(rec1[2], rec2[2]) > max(rec1[0], rec2[0]) for x-axis and min(rec1[3], rec2[3]) > max(rec1[1], rec2[1]) for y-axis.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
from typing import List

class Solution:
    def isRectangleOverlap(self, rec1: List[int], rec2: List[int]) -> bool:
        overlap_x = min(rec1[2], rec2[2]) > max(rec1[0], rec2[0])
        overlap_y = min(rec1[3], rec2[3]) > max(rec1[1], rec2[1])
        return overlap_x and overlap_y
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Non-strict inequality (>=) treats zero-area boundary touch or point touch as overlapping.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Reduce 2D geometric overlap to two independent 1D interval intersections.
